args.title: Remember the last-used export format in the browser
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

ExportButton always initializes its format select from the defaultFormat prop (which defaults to "csv"), so it never reflects what the user picked last time. Persist the chosen format to localStorage (e.g. under a "ledgerline.exportFormat" key) on change, and read it back as the initial state when the component mounts, falling back to defaultFormat when nothing is stored.

file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton's format <select> always starts from the defaultFormat prop ("csv"), with nothing persisted between visits. The fix is to store the chosen format (e.g. in localStorage) whenever it changes, and initialize the component's state from that stored value, falling back to defaultFormat when none is set.
